pattern: 半导体设备龙头上调年度销售指引（AI 需求驱动）
rationale: ASML raising its 2026 sales forecast on strong AI-driven lithography demand is a direct positive earnings catalyst for the company itself. Guidance raises typically drive a 3-6% re-rating in mega-cap semiconductor equipment names within days.

pattern: 半导体设备龙头上调指引 → 半导体板块整体受益
rationale: ASML is a bellwether for the semiconductor capital-equipment cycle. A guidance raise citing AI demand validates continued capex from TSMC/Samsung/Intel and lifts the broader semi/semi-equipment complex (SOXX holds ASML, AMAT, LRCX, KLAC).

pattern: 上游半导体设备商确认 AI 资本开支强劲 → AI 算力龙头受益
rationale: ASML explicitly attributes the upgraded forecast to AI-driven demand, reinforcing the AI capex narrative. NVDA, as the primary beneficiary of AI accelerator demand, typically rallies on upstream confirmations of sustained AI investment.

rationale: Aixtron raising its 2026 sales outlook is a direct positive guidance revision. Upward guidance revisions from mid-cap semiconductor equipment suppliers typically trigger a sharp short-term rally as analysts revise estimates and momentum traders pile in. The news text confirms shares are already jumping.

pattern: 半导体设备商上调指引→板块情绪外溢
rationale: Positive guidance from a chip-equipment supplier like Aixtron is typically read as a leading indicator of healthy capex from foundries/IDMs, giving a modest same-day/next-day lift to the broader semiconductor index as sentiment spills over to peers (AMAT, LRCX, ASML).

pattern: 欧洲半导体设备商上调指引→同业ASML联动
rationale: ASML is the bellwether European semi-equipment peer to Aixtron. Aixtron's stronger outlook signals resilient demand for deposition/MOCVD tools in compound semis and power/RF applications, which is read-through positive for the broader European WFE complex including ASML.

pattern: 中国限制对美光伏制造设备出口 -> 美国本土光伏制造商
rationale: First Solar is the largest US-based solar panel manufacturer with minimal reliance on Chinese manufacturing equipment. Curbs on Chinese solar equipment exports to the US constrain competitors' ability to build new US capacity, reinforcing FSLR's domestic moat and pricing power.

pattern: 中国限制对美光伏制造设备出口 -> 美国光伏板块ETF
rationale: TAN holds a mix of US solar installers/developers and global module makers. Restrictions on Chinese solar manufacturing equipment raise capex and delay US domestic capacity ramp for many holdings, pressuring the broader solar ETF despite pockets of relative winners.
